home.tagline: Review shops, moderate products, run categories and search, and see who did what.
home.title: Admin console
home.shopsHint: Shops waiting for review, and every shop by status or name.
home.countriesHint: Where people may sign up by phone, and the countries goods come from.
home.productsHint: Food and restricted products waiting for review before they show.
home.categoriesHint: The category tree in each language, and which categories are reviewed.
home.emiratesHint: Open customer search per emirate, and rebuild the search index.
home.auditHint: Who did what in this console, and when.

admin.notAllowedWhy: Ask an admin to give your account the admin role, then sign in again.

countries.title: Countries
countries.intro: Where new accounts may sign up by phone, and which countries shops and products can come from. Changes show in the apps within five minutes.
countries.name: Name
countries.loadFailed: The countries could not be loaded.
countries.saveFailed: That change was not saved. Try again.

shops.title: Shops
shops.intro: Shops sent for review wait here, oldest first. Find any shop by name to suspend or reinstate it.
shops.search: Search by shop name or web address
shops.queueEmpty: No shop is waiting for review

decision.title: Decision
decision.kycFirst: The shop can go live once the owner's identity check has passed.
decision.approveBody: It appears in search at once, in every emirate where search is open. The seller is told.
decision.rejectBody: The seller reads your reason, can fix the shop and send it again.
decision.suspendBody: It leaves search and its page closes at once. The seller reads your reason.
decision.reinstateBody: It appears in search again at once.

identity.title: Identity check
identity.notStarted: The owner has not started the identity check.
identity.noResult: No result from the identity provider yet.
identity.imagesHint: Fetched from the provider when you open one. Each view is recorded with your name.

license.title: Trade licence
license.none: No trade licence sent. Only needed for online checkout.
license.approveBody: The details match the document and the licence is valid. The legal name and number show on the shop's page.
license.rejectBody: The seller reads your reason and can send another.

profile.title: Shop page
profile.processing: {n, plural, one {# photo is} other {# photos are}} still being processed.

decision.reasonHint: The seller reads this. Say what to change.
decision.reasonRequired: Write the reason the seller will read.

documents.noPreview: This document cannot be shown here. Download it instead.

products.title: Products to review
products.intro: Food, restricted categories and products rejected before wait here, oldest first. Approved products show at once.
products.empty: No product is waiting for review
products.declared: Packaged and labelled; not a restricted item
products.approveBody: It shows to customers at once, if the shop is live.
products.rejectBody: The seller reads your reason and can fix the product and send it again.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: Shops and products are filed under these. Products in restricted or food categories are reviewed before they show.
categories.children: {n, plural, one {# category under it} other {# categories under it}}
categories.restrictedHint: Every product in it waits for an admin.
categories.declarationHint: Sellers confirm the food is packaged, labelled and allowed. Reviewed too.
categories.checkoutAllowedHint: Untick for what must never go through checkout, such as money transfer.
categories.activeHint: Switched off, it is hidden with everything under it and takes no new products.
categories.nameFrHint: English is shown until it is set.
categories.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Changing it breaks old links.
categories.namesRequired: Enter the name in English and in Arabic.

invalid.slug_taken: Another category uses this web address.
invalid.loop: A category cannot go under itself or under one of its own.
invalid.too_deep: Categories go three levels deep at most.
invalid.kind_is_fixed: What a category lists cannot change once it exists.
invalid.kind_differs_from_parent: It must list the same as the category it goes under.

emiratesSearch.title: Emirates
emiratesSearch.intro: Customers can search in an emirate once it is open. Open one when it has enough verified shops.
emiratesSearch.openBody: Customers there will find its {shops} verified shops at once.
emiratesSearch.openEmptyBody: It has no verified shop yet, so customers there will find nothing.
emiratesSearch.closeBody: Customers there will no longer find any shop. Shops keep their pages.
emiratesSearch.rebuildBody: Search keeps its own copy of shops and products, updated as they change. If it ever looks wrong, rebuild it from the shops and the catalogue.
emiratesSearch.rebuildConfirmBody: Every verified shop is read again. It can take a few minutes; search keeps working meanwhile.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every decision, document opened and setting changed by an admin, newest first. Entries are never changed or removed.
